For each J_n={n,...,2n-1}, the exact difference identity Delta D E^(n)=D^-1(I-K) has K_{ab}=a log(a/(a-1))-1 on a>b, bounded by 1/n. Length-j chains yield ||K^j||<=1/j!, so the n-by-n inverse norm <=8e n² and the compression inequality gives s_n(E)>=1/(8en²). The finite code was inspected; it checks small identities and is not used as an infinite proof.
